user_story: As a user, I want task creation to fail when an invalid category is provided so that data stays consistent.

positive.title: Task creation with a valid category
steps: Log into the application.
Navigate to the task creation page.
Enter a valid task name and description.
Select a valid category from the dropdown list.
Click on the 'Create Task' button.
positive.expected_result: Task is created successfully with the selected valid category.

negative.title: Task creation with an invalid category
steps: Log into the application.
Navigate to the task creation page.
Enter a valid task name and description.
Enter an invalid category that is not available in the dropdown list.
Click on the 'Create Task' button.
negative.expected_result: Task creation fails with an error message indicating an invalid category.

negative.title: Task creation without selecting any category
steps: Log into the application.
Navigate to the task creation page.
Enter a valid task name and description.
Leave the category selection empty.
Click on the 'Create Task' button.
negative.expected_result: Task creation fails with an error message indicating that a category must be selected.

edge.title: Task creation with category input as special characters
steps: Log into the application.
Navigate to the task creation page.
Enter a valid task name and description.
Enter special characters into the category field.
Click on the 'Create Task' button.
edge.expected_result: Task creation fails with an error message indicating an invalid category format.

edge.title: Task creation with maximum character limit for category input
steps: Log into the application.
Navigate to the task creation page.
Enter a valid task name and description.
Enter a category name with the maximum allowed characters.
Click on the 'Create Task' button.
edge.expected_result: Task creation succeeds if the category is valid or fails with an error if it exceeds the limit or is invalid.
